svg.aria-label: A commit that names itself. Its id is the author's address, a colon, and a SHA-256 of the repository, the parents, the message, the content and the time. Two consequences: on any peer, an operation on an id that begins with an address must be signed by that address, so nobody else can create, rewrite or delete the commit; and changing one byte of the content produces another id, so the author cannot rewrite it either without leaving the old one where it was.
svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: The id is built by the author and enforced by every peer
sha-256( repo · parents · message · content · time )
An id that begins with an address names its owner:
on a peer that never saw the node, an op on it is
accepted only when signed by that address.
The author cannot rewrite it either
Change one byte of the content, the parents or the
message and the hash changes: that is a new commit,
and the old one stays where every peer keeps it.
